title: Race Condition Debugging Checklist — Python, Go, Java
title_es: Checklist de debugging de race conditions — Python, Go, Java
description: Runnable reproductions for the race condition debugging checklist: brute-force stress test, barrier-forced interleaving, jcstress memory-model test and a Go -race demo with its mutex fix.
description_es: Reproducciones ejecutables del checklist de debugging de race conditions: stress test por fuerza bruta, interleaving forzado con barreras, test de modelo de memoria con jcstress y demo de Go -race con su fix con mutex.
